if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n$ be a nonnegative nonincreasing real sequence, and suppose the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ diverges. Prove that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} \min\{a_n,1/n\}$ diverges.

callouts.body: 意识到$b_n:=\min\{a_n,1/n\}$也是一个非负单调不增的实数列，对于这种数列构成的级数，通过基于dyadic分解的估计可以得到其收敛的充要条件，这种技术被柯西封装为[[柯西凝聚判别法]]。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be two nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences, and suppose both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Must the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ also diverge?

callouts.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#5
callouts.title: 想法2.3
callouts.body:
反例构造的基本想法是，构造$\alpha_n$是一个下降阶梯一样的序列。每个阶梯上，函数是常值，而阶梯整体上是不断下降的，后面的阶梯比前面的阶梯更低。

假设每一个阶梯的长度为$L_k$每一段阶梯上的常值为$F_k$那么只要$F_k\geq F_{k+1}$,那么此时构造出来的序列就是单调不整的。此时序列的的和为$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n = \sum_{k\geq 1}L_k F_k$$要使得$\alpha_n$的和发散只要$L_kF_k$衰减很慢，甚至不衰减（比如$F_k=\frac{1}{k},L_k=k$）就行。我们用同样的方式构造$\beta_n$，比如阶梯长度用序列$L_k$控制，每段阶梯上的常数序列为$G_k$，那么只要使得$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n = \sum_{k\geq 1}L_k G_k=+\infty$$就可以让$\beta_n$也满足条件。但是我们现在要构造$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$收敛，那么就要好好权衡$L_k,G_k,F_k$三者之间的关系了。因为我们需要$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}=\sum_{k\geq 1}L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}<+\infty$$也就是说：
1. $L_k$整体趋势上需得是增加的（但不必单调），并且增长不能太慢，因为要保证$L_kG_k,L_kF_k$是不能衰减太快。
2. $\min\{F_k,G_k\}$又要衰减得足够快，以至于$L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}$衰减得足够快，从而$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$是收敛的。

为了解决以上困难，我们这样考虑：
* 我们先选取一列$u_k\downarrow 0$，使得$\sum_k u_k <+\infty$。然后取整数序列$L_k$使得存在无穷多个$L_k u_k \geq  c>0$,从而使得$\sum_k L_k u_k=+\infty$
* 我们再选取一列$v_k \downarrow 0$满足$v_k\leq u_k$并且使得$L_k v_k$衰减得足够快，以至于$\sum_{k} L_k v_k <+\infty$。
* 然后这两个序列按照下面的次序构成$\alpha_n,\beta_n$的每一段阶梯上的值：$$\alpha_n:v_{2k}\geq u_{2k+1}>v_{2k+2}\geq u_{2k+3}$$以及$$\beta_n:u_{2k}>v_{2k+1}\geq u_{2k+2}>v_{2k+3}$$

这样一来$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n = \sum_{k\text{ odd}}L_kv_k + \sum_{k \text{ even}} L_ku_k$$以及$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n = \sum_{k\text{ even}}L_kv_k + \sum_{k \text{ odd}} L_ku_k$$两个都是发散级数，但是$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\} =\sum_{k} L_k v_k<\infty$$

classification_result.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#5

if_strategy_template.summary_en: Construct each sequence as a decreasing step function on long blocks, with block lengths and heights tuned so that each individual series diverges while the blockwise minimum becomes summable. The key is to alternate which sequence is large on each block and make the smaller block height decay fast enough.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when one needs a counterexample involving two nonnegative nonincreasing divergent series whose termwise minimum is nevertheless summable.

callouts.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#6
callouts.title: 反例2.3
callouts.body:
关于以上分析，一个解决方案是令$$F_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^k}&k是奇数 \\ 2^{-2^{k+1}} &k是偶数\end{cases},G_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^{k+1}}&k是奇数 \\ 2^{-2^{k}} &k是偶数\end{cases},L_k=2^{2^{k}}$$如此一来:
1. 当$k$是奇数的时候$L_kF_k=1$当$k$是偶数的时候$L_kF_k=\frac{1}{2^{2^k}}$于是这足以保证$\alpha_n$对应的级数的发散性。
2. 当$k$是偶数的时候$L_kG_k=\frac{1}{2^{2^k}}$，当$k$是奇数的时候$L_kG_k=1$这足以保证$\beta_n$对应的级数的发散性。

此时
$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}=\sum_{k\geq 1}L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}=\sum_{k\geq 1} \frac{1}{2^{2^k}}<+\infty$$

classification_result.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#6

if_problem.statement_en:
A concrete construction is given by
$$F_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^k}&k\text{ is odd} \\ 2^{-2^{k+1}} &k\text{ is even}\end{cases},\qquad G_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^{k+1}}&k\text{ is odd} \\ 2^{-2^{k}} &k\text{ is even}\end{cases},\qquad L_k=2^{2^{k}}.$$ Then the block sequences $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ built from these data satisfy that both corresponding series diverge, while
$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}=\sum_{k\geq 1}L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}=\sum_{k\geq 1} \frac{1}{2^{2^k}}<+\infty.$$

classification_result.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#7

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences such that both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Assume moreover that there exists a positive real number $c$ such that for all sufficiently large $n$,
$$2^n\beta_{2^n}\geq c >0.$$ Then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ diverges.

callouts.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#8
callouts.title: 引理2.5
callouts.body: 设$a_n$是一个非负，单调不增的实数列，且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$发散。如果$S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$是自然的一个子集，其自然密度为正，即$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0$$那么子级数$\sum_{n\in S}a_n$也发散。

classification_result.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#8

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $a_n$ be a nonnegative nonincreasing real sequence such that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$ diverges. If $S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ has positive natural density, that is,
$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0,$$
then the subseries $\sum_{n\in S}a_n$ also diverges.

Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative locally integrable nonincreasing function on $[1,+\infty)$, and suppose
$$\int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=+\infty.$$ Then
$$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\min\{f(x),\frac{1}{x}\}\,dx=+\infty.$$

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Transfer Dyadic Condensation from Series to Integrals
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When the discrete argument relies on dyadic decomposition, apply the same blockwise estimation to an improper integral. This works especially well for a nonnegative nonincreasing function such as $g(x):=\min\{f(x),1/x\}$.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when converting a convergence or divergence argument for monotone series into the analogous statement for improper integrals.

callouts.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#12
callouts.title: 引理3.3:积分的凝聚判别法
callouts.body:
设函数$f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：
1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[1,M]$上都是黎曼可积的。
2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。

那么广义积分$\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$收敛。

classification_result.id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#12

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy:
1. $f(x)$ is locally integrable on this interval, that is, it is Riemann integrable on every closed interval $[1,M]$.
2. $f(x)$ is nonnegative and nonincreasing on this interval.

Then the improper integral $\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ converges if and only if the series $\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$ converges.

1. $0<p\leq 1$发散。
2. $p>1$收敛。

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative locally integrable nonincreasing function on $[1,+\infty)$, and suppose
$$\int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=+\infty.$$ Then the integral
$$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\min\{f(x),\frac{1}{x^p}\}\,dx$$
satisfies:
1. it diverges for $0<p\leq 1$;
2. it converges for $p>1$.
